bifrost: springboard/ui/src/evaluation.rs (Evaluation, Sample, Evaluator, Metric, MetricsAggregator, EvaluationResult, TrajectoryExpectation); springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs (TestWindow, UI testing kit only); springboard/apps/assistant-desktop/src/model.rs (model runner, not yet wired to the evaluation harness)
summary: BifrOSt now has a pure evaluation harness: a suite runs a responder over samples, scores each response with closure evaluators, summarizes metrics, and checks tool-call trajectories. Datasets, loaders, sample generation, model-judge scoring and the Swift Testing trait are still missing, and the Assistant does not run the harness yet.

features.note: A suite of evaluators runs a responder over samples and collects rows and errors. The Assistant app does not define or run suites yet.
Sample holds an input and an optional expected value. There is no Loader protocol and no SampleGenerator, so synthetic datasets are not produced.
Closure evaluators and pass or fail checks score each response. The aggregator gives count, mean, median, min, max, variance and standard deviation. No mode, custom aggregation or metric grouping.
Rows hold input, response, expected and metrics, read by Column. There is no typed DataFrame and no column type that carries its value type.
No LLM-as-judge scoring. An evaluator is a closure, so a judge would need a model call supplied by the caller.

Ordered steps, unordered calls, disallowed calls and extra-call policy are checked, and argument rules cover exact, key-only, one-of, numeric range, contains, prefix and suffix. Regex and natural-language argument matching are not implemented.
The SDK testing kit (TestWindow, click and state assertions) covers UI tests. It has no evaluation trait and does not attach evaluation results.

gaps: The Assistant app does not define or run evaluation suites against its model yet.
No Loader protocol and no SampleGenerator for synthetic datasets; datasets are built in code only.
No model-judge scoring: ModelJudgeEvaluator, ModelJudgePrompt and ScoreDimension are missing.
Argument matching has no regex or natural-language rule (ArgumentMatcher.pattern and naturalLanguage).
Aggregation has no mode, custom aggregation or metric groups (MetricsAggregator.group).
The result table is not a typed DataFrame: no ResultColumn value types.
No evaluation trait for the test kit; springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs does not run or attach evaluations.
